def test_prime_length():
    # Non-prime lengths (composite or trivial)
    assert prime_length("") == False          # length 0
    assert prime_length("a") == False         # length 1
    assert prime_length("abab") == False      # length 4
    assert prime_length("orange") == False    # length 6
    assert prime_length("abcdefgh") == False  # length 8
    assert prime_length("a" * 9) == False     # length 9
    assert prime_length("a" * 10) == False    # length 10

    # Prime lengths
    assert prime_length("ab") == True         # length 2
    assert prime_length("abc") == True        # length 3
    assert prime_length("Hello") == True      # length 5
    assert prime_length("abcdcba") == True    # length 7
    assert prime_length("kittens") == True    # length 7
    assert prime_length("a" * 11) == True     # length 11
    assert prime_length("a" * 13) == True     # length 13
    assert prime_length("a" * 97) == True     # length 97

    print("All test cases passed!")

    assert prime_length("aaaaaaa") == True
